items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered a dislocated left elbow (same as last year), X-rays negative for fracture, ruled OUT; expected to miss time (~month last occurrence). Additional testing Monday.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on awkward fall bracing; prior history prolongs recovery.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; Marcus Mariota likely starts. Fantasy QB streaming/ waiver needed.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers may see adjusted roles short-term.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, carted off, ruled out remainder of game; imaging/MRI Monday. Walked under own power postgame with slight limp.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring on scramble/run; severity TBD via Monday imaging.
items.implication: Potential multi-week absence; mobility key to his game so caution likely. Backup (Tyson Bagent) impact.
items.opportunity: Bears skill players volume may shift with backup QB.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE; optimism confirmed, wore flak jacket possible.
items.why: Cleared after GTD with cracked rib; Rap bullish tone.
items.implication: Start with confidence; docks for limited practice but projected in.
items.opportunity: Full target share expected if healthy enough.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman now as beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; not expected to play per pregame.
items.implication: Clear path for backup RB usage/snaps.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) questionable/true GTD for MNF vs Giants; missed practices, trending wrong direction/more likely out per reports. Pre-game decision.
items.implication: If OUT, Adams primary, others (Parkinson etc) rise; monitor official.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams and secondary WRs target/route bump if inactive.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Sean Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.why: Clear lead back snaps/carries/routes postgame data.
items.implication: Irving locked as lead; Gainwell handcuff only.
items.opportunity: High snap share, goal-line, third-down for Irving.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley suffered stinger, missed most of first half but played through it with neck roll; MRI today, hope is minor injury.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; if minor, full go Week 3. Handcuff watch if worse.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Gainwell or others expand.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by HC Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3 with minimal docks.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers: “Close, very close. He looks great.” (was doubtful/out recently).
items.implication: Imminent return elevates TE1 value ROS; monitor practice.
Bateman and others elevated targets; Ravens WR hierarchy shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share for remaining WRs/TEs.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Expect look at Germie Bernard.
items.implication: Slot/YAC opportunities open; Bernard stash fit with McCarthy.
items.opportunity: Germie Bernard or other Colts WRs expand routes/targets.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble discipline + weapon needs + Brown absence.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion/carries/routes even if Stevenson plays.
items.opportunity: Explosive plays, more snaps for Henderson.

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading WRs in expected PPR. RIDE OR DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.
items.implication: Must-start WR; high floor/ceiling on volume.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 yards per route run this season; among worst WRs (only few worse).
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite volume; monitor for breakout or continued struggle.
